notes.title: Shadow Over Isolation demo version is coming to Steam soon!
notes.notes: We have exciting news - free demo version of our newest title Shadow Over Isolation is coming to Steam soon. Remember to add Shadow Over Isolation to your wishlist and stay tuned for further information about the release!
